title: The Deep Repository of Unspoken Growth

features.name: the seed cartography
features.desc-on-touch: You read the rows of filed seeds—some dated, some marked with hopes written in fading pencil. The archive has learned to catalogue futures.

features.name: the patient darkness
features.desc-on-touch: Deep stillness surrounds you. Each seed waits for a climate it may never feel, a soil that may not exist yet. Patience has geology here.

features.name: the clay vessels
features.desc-on-touch: Terracotta vessels line the stone—each one holding a generation's hope, unnamed and unplanted. The archive keeps what the world has not yet asked for.

features.name: the germination record
features.desc-on-touch: A ledger rendered in living root-trace, documenting what did not sprout, what waited in darkness for decades, what finally broke through.

features.name: the unplanted archive
features.desc-on-touch: Rows of seeds that will outlive the trees they were taken from. You wonder if this repository is a garden or a tomb.

inscription: before growth speaks, all utterance waits in darkness as seed

file.name: Seed_Lineage_Archive_Incomplete_Dating.txt
file.note: A catalogue of propagules collected from stands now fallen, their names corrupted into poetic drift—waratah becomes 'where-anger-touches-height'; kurrajong becomes 'the-current-running-underground'.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the repository, late afternoon
narr: You kneel beside Katita in the stone shed, each of you
holding a handful of seeds she'd collected years before.
She knows their stories—which tree, which season, which
town has since forgotten its own eucalyptus. You're both
pressing them into clay, making records the earth will read.
The petals falling outside the door taste like half-remembered things.

exits.label: back toward the place where seeds still dream in darkness
deeper still, where the oldest seeds remember being something else
down to the root-place where all seeds converge in the soil
